summary: Root cause identified with medium confidence (0.60): order-service deployment dep-5101 (v2.14.0, rolled out 12:10:08Z, 2026-03-03) introduced the new MarginCheckValidator, which dereferences marginProfile without a null guard (MarginCheckValidator.java:88) and throws NullPointerException that is returned as HTTP 500 for FNO (derivatives) orders only. This matches the exact change set of the deploy, the FNO-only scope of all 426 error entries, the error onset 2m23s after rollout completion, and the absence of any other deployment or config change across all services in the window. Competing hypotheses (bad margin data, shared dependency degradation, deploy-independent order-service bug) are markedly weaker and largely contradicted by the strict FNO scope, the flat p99 latency, and the absence of any other change in the window. The one material gap is that no dependency telemetry was queried, so a silent shared-component degradation cannot be positively excluded from metrics — the exclusion rests on change-list evidence only.

ranked_hypotheses.title: order-service v2.14.0 bad deployment: MarginCheckValidator NPE on FNO orders
ranked_hypotheses.statement: order-service deploy dep-5101 (v2.14.0, 12:10:08Z) replaced legacy OrderRules.validateMargin() with a new MarginCheckValidator in the validation chain. The new validator dereferences marginProfile without a null guard (MarginCheckValidator.java:88), throwing NullPointerException for FNO (derivatives) orders. The NPE is uncaught upstream, so POST /v1/orders returns HTTP 500. Because the new validator only runs on F&O orders, only derivatives orders fail, matching the ticket skew.

causal_chain.claim: order-service deploys dep-5101 v2.14.0 at 12:10:08Z, introducing new MarginCheckValidator and removing legacy OrderRules.validateMargin()
New validator code path runs during F&O order validation; marginProfile from account/lookup is null for these accounts
MarginCheckValidator.validate (line 88) dereferences marginProfile without a null guard -> NullPointerException
NPE propagates as order rejection -> HTTP 500 'order rejected with 500' on POST /v1/orders
Only F&O orders traverse the new validator, so failures are confined to orderType=FNO

assumptions: marginProfile is expected to be non-null for some accounts and the legacy validateMargin() tolerated/read it differently; no field-by-field diff of old vs new code was available
the NPE is not caught by an outer handler and converted to 500 (verified by error signature 'order rejected with 500')

ranked_hypotheses.title: FNO margin data missing/null in backing store (data_issue) - new validator exposes missing marginProfile
ranked_hypotheses.statement: The origin of the fault is the data: accounts placing F&O orders have no marginProfile record (or an unpopulated one) in the upstream margin/account data. The new MarginCheckValidator is merely the first code to strictly require it, so it NPEs. Fix would be data-side (populate/repair marginProfile) rather than code rollback.

causal_chain.claim: F&O-trading accounts lack a marginProfile row (or the field is null) in the margin source
Prior code (legacy OrderRules.validateMargin) tolerated the missing profile, masking the gap
New MarginCheckValidator requires the field and dereferences it -> NPE at line 88
NPE -> HTTP 500 for FNO orders only

assumptions: marginProfile data is stored in the backing store and was already null before 12:10Z
no code path in the new deploy could itself produce a null marginProfile (e.g. a lookup key change)

ranked_hypotheses.title: Shared dependency degradation returns null margin data (dependency_failure on ledger-db/redis-cache)
ranked_hypotheses.statement: A shared component order-service calls (ledger-db, or redis-cache holding margin profiles) degraded in the onset window, returning null/empty account-margin data. The new MarginCheckValidator surfaces this as an NPE. Blast radius would extend to other order-service operations, but only the new strict validator fails hard.

causal_chain.claim: Margin profile lookup returns null instead of a profile
MarginCheckValidator NPEs on the null profile
500 on POST /v1/orders for the affected orders

assumptions: a dependency returned null rather than erroring/timing out
the degradation left no deploy/config trace (it is a silent degradation, not a change)

ranked_hypotheses.title: Reporter's premise: order-service itself regressed independent of the deploy (generic order-service bug/regression)
ranked_hypotheses.statement: order-service developed an internal defect (its own code/logic) causing 500s on POST /v1/orders, not tied to dep-5101's specific change to margin validation, and the deploy is coincidental. Would predict failures across order types and/or attributable to a pre-existing code path.

causal_chain.claim: order-service has an intrinsic defect in order placement

assumptions: the error onset at 12:12:31Z is not causally related to the 12:10:08Z deploy of the F&O margin refactor
ranked_hypotheses.rejection_reason: The first and dominant error is a NullPointerException inside MarginCheckValidator (new in dep-5101), exclusively on orderType=FNO - the exact code path and order type the deploy targeted. Onset 2m23s after rollout completion, no other service changed. A deploy-independent bug cannot explain the strict FNO-only scope and the validator-specific stack frame.

facts.statement: Only two deployments occurred across all services between 06:00Z and 13:59Z: portfolio-service v4.2.1 at 09:36Z and order-service v2.14.0 (dep-5101, author r.iyer) at 12:10Z; no other service deployed in the window.

dep-5101's change set is exactly on the derivatives validation path: 'new MarginCheckValidator in validation chain' and 'remove legacy OrderRules.validateMargin()', summary 'Refactor order validation; add margin check for F&O orders'; status live with rolled_back_at null at fetch time.

The first order-service error in the window is a NullPointerException at MarginCheckValidator.validate(MarginCheckValidator.java:88) with orderType=FNO, orderId=9326cc69; dominant patterns are that NPE (224 occurrences) and 'order rejected with 500: java.lang.NullPointerException: marginProfile is null for account <n>' (202 occurrences).
The 500 signature is java.lang.NullPointerException: marginProfile is null, thrown inside MarginCheckValidator.validate at line 88, surfacing as HTTP 500 'order rejected with 500'.
All 426 ERROR log entries carry orderType=FNO; no non-FNO order type appears among failures, and a post-12:22 filtered query returned exclusively FNO NPE patterns (204 matches).
order-service error_rate jumped from a ~0.2% baseline to 14.74% in the 12:10-12:20 bucket and stayed at ~18-20% through the end of data (13:50 bucket avg 18.76%, max 19.82%).
order-service p99 latency is flat across the incident (12:10 bucket 151.76ms, 12:00 bucket 150.32ms, 13:50 bucket 150.55ms) — no latency degradation accompanies the error spike.
api-gateway error_rate rose in the same window from ~0.2% baseline to ~3.3-3.45%, consistent with propagating order-service 500s at a much smaller magnitude.

The only config change anywhere in the window was notification-service email.batch_size 200->250 at 11:21Z (cfg-2101), which touches neither order-service nor its dependencies and predates onset by ~51 minutes; order-service had zero config changes in the extended window 2026-02-20 to 2026-03-03T13:59Z.

order-service's dependency set includes shared components ledger-db (postgres), redis-cache (redis) and kafka (kafka), plus http deps pricing-engine and exchange-gateway and queue-produce kafka; none of these had a deployment or config change in the window.

Historical precedent for this exact signature (500 on POST /v1/orders for derivatives orders, margin-validator NPE) was not found; nearest precedents involve different mechanisms (connection pool misconfiguration, ledger-db IOPS throttling, external exchange 504, JWT library upgrade).

recommended_actions.action: Roll back order-service dep-5101 (v2.14.0) to the last known-good version now — this is the single change that coincides with onset and touches the exact failing path.
recommended_actions.rationale: dep-5101 is still live with rolled_back_at null; it added the MarginCheckValidator that throws the NPE and removed the legacy OrderRules.validateMargin() that presumably tolerated null marginProfile. Rollback is the direct mitigation for the FNO-only 500s.

recommended_actions.action: After rollback, verify recovery: confirm order-service error_rate returns to the ~0.2% baseline and that POST /v1/orders for orderType=FNO succeeds, then confirm api-gateway error_rate returns to baseline.
recommended_actions.rationale: The error_rate jump (0.2% -> ~19%) and api-gateway propagation are the observed signals; recovery should mirror them. If error_rate stays elevated after rollback, H2/H3 (data or dependency cause) remain live and must be pursued.

recommended_actions.action: Fix MarginCheckValidator.java:88 to handle a null marginProfile (explicit null guard or default/fallback to legacy behavior) and ship in a follow-up v2.14.x release; add a unit test for FNO orders with null marginProfile before re-deploying the F&O margin check.
recommended_actions.rationale: The NPE is a missing null guard at a specific line; the fix must preserve the intended margin check for F&O orders without 500-ing on null profiles.

recommended_actions.action: Query order-service dependency telemetry around onset (ledger-db error rate/latency/IOPS, redis-cache hit rate/evictions, kafka broker/consumer lag, pricing-engine and exchange-gateway call status codes) to close the remaining gap on H3 and confirm no silent shared-component degradation contributed.
recommended_actions.rationale: The exclusion of shared-dependency degradation currently rests only on absence of deploy/config entries, not on dependency health metrics — this data was never queried.

recommended_actions.action: Verify the marginProfile data path against failing accounts: check whether marginProfile records for the affected accounts are null in the backing store and whether the new validator's lookup key differs from legacy OrderRules.validateMargin(), to confirm the fault is code-side rather than data-side.
recommended_actions.rationale: H2 (null margin data in the store) remains formally possible and would require a data-side repair instead of / in addition to the code fix; currently supported only indirectly.

recommended_actions.action: Add pre-deployment integration coverage that exercises the F&O validation path with null/absent marginProfile, and add a deploy-correlated error-rate canary (auto-alert or auto-rollback on FNO-only 500 spike within minutes of rollout).
recommended_actions.rationale: The incident was detectable 2m23s after rollout via a clear NPE signature and a 2-order-of-magnitude error-rate jump; gating deploys on this path and alerting on deploy-correlated error-rate deltas prevents recurrence.

recommended_actions.action: Fall back to the change-diff discipline: require a field-by-field behavioral comparison of removed legacy code (OrderRules.validateMargin) versus its replacement before merging refactors on the order validation chain.
recommended_actions.rationale: The refactor removed legacy behavior that presumably tolerated null marginProfile; no field-by-field old-vs-new diff was available during this investigation, which slowed confirmation.

Evidence that marginProfile records for the affected accounts are missing/null in the backing store independently of the new code (e.g. a pre-12:10Z data state), or that the new validator's lookup key changed and returns null where legacy code found data — shifts root cause toward H2.
